name: Opening
title: 让每个重要时刻，都被感知

voice.zh: 有些重要的时刻，从一个声音开始。
voice.en: Some meaningful moments begin with a sound.

voice.zh: 一声门铃，一句问候，一次擦肩而过。
voice.en: A doorbell. A greeting. Someone passing by.

voice.zh: 让这些连接，被更多人感知。
voice.en: Make those connections easier to notice.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，构想一款独立运行的声音感知手表。
voice.en: SoundBridge imagines a standalone sound-aware watch.

voice.zh: 采集、识别、提醒，都在腕上完成。
voice.en: Sensing, recognition and alerts — all on the wrist.

voice.zh: 麦克风采集声音，将短时音频转换为频谱特征。
voice.en: Microphones capture audio; short windows become spectral features.

voice.zh: 轻量模型在本地，区分门铃、人声、车铃和鸣笛。
voice.en: A local model distinguishes doorbells, speech, bicycle bells and horns.

voice.zh: 再通过置信度判断、连续确认与重复抑制，减少无效打扰。
voice.en: Confidence checks, temporal confirmation and deduplication limit unwanted alerts.

name: Home
title: 不错过，一个熟悉的到来

voice.zh: 门铃响起，识别结果触发专属振动，屏幕显示门铃事件。
voice.en: A recognized doorbell triggers its haptic pattern and an on-screen event.

voice.zh: 即使正在忙碌，也能知道有人来访。何时回应，由你决定。
voice.en: Notice a visitor while you are busy. Choose when to respond.

name: Conversation
title: 让加入对话，多一个线索

voice.zh: 开启交谈模式，系统优先提醒附近的人声。
voice.en: Conversation mode prioritizes nearby speech.

voice.zh: 一次轻柔长振，提醒你抬头看看。
voice.en: One gentle, sustained pulse invites you to look up.

voice.zh: 它提示有人说话，不判断对方是否正在叫你。
voice.en: It detects speech, not whether someone is addressing you.

name: Outdoors
title: 感知身边，保持自己的步调

voice.zh: 户外模式关注车铃与鸣笛，识别后发送短促振动。
voice.en: Outdoor mode focuses on bicycle bells and horns, with brief pulses.

voice.zh: 停一停，看看周围，再由自己判断下一步。
voice.en: Pause, look around, and decide your next move.

voice.zh: 这是环境提示，不替代道路观察。
voice.en: An awareness cue that does not replace looking around.

voice.zh: 事件类别，映射到不同的振动节奏。
voice.en: Each event category maps to a different haptic rhythm.

voice.zh: 门铃是两组双击，人声是一段长振，交通提示是三次短振。
voice.en: Doorbell: two paired taps. Speech: one long pulse. Traffic: three short taps.

voice.zh: 驱动触觉马达，让声音有了可学习的触感。
voice.en: A haptic actuator turns sound categories into learnable sensations.

voice.zh: 方向提示，需要兼容的多麦克风硬件。
voice.en: Direction cues require compatible multi-microphone hardware.

voice.zh: 比较声音到达不同麦克风的时间差，估计来向。
voice.en: Compare arrival times across microphones to estimate the source direction.

voice.zh: 表盘用柔和扇区，提示大致方向。
voice.en: A soft sector indicates an approximate direction.

voice.zh: 精度仍需在真实噪声和佩戴条件下验证。
voice.en: Accuracy still needs validation with real noise and wrist placement.

voice.zh: 首次使用，开启感知，选择声音，再试一试振动。
voice.en: Start awareness, choose your sounds, then preview the vibration.

voice.zh: 只接收选中的声音，文字大小与振动强度也能调整。
voice.en: Choose the sounds to receive, plus text size and vibration strength.

voice.zh: 把偏好保存在本地，让提醒更适合自己。
voice.en: Store preferences locally so alerts fit your needs.

voice.zh: 居家、交谈、户外，切换的是声音筛选规则。
voice.en: Home, conversation and outdoors apply different sound filters.

voice.zh: 想安静时，暂停感知，停止采集与提醒。
voice.en: Pause awareness to stop capture and alerts when you want quiet.

voice.zh: 准备好了，再轻触恢复。
voice.en: Tap to resume when you are ready.

name: Privacy
title: 让私人的时刻，留在腕上

voice.zh: 方案默认在设备内处理，不保存原始录音。
voice.en: The proposed default is local processing without saving raw recordings.

voice.zh: 若启用事件历史，只保留类别与时间，并由用户管理。
voice.en: If event history is enabled, keep category and time under user control.

voice.zh: 这些隐私目标，仍需在最终软硬件中落实。
voice.en: These privacy goals must be implemented in the final hardware and software.

name: Closing
title: 科技的温度，是把选择交还给你

voice.zh: 下一步，与聋人及重听人士共同设计、测试、完善。
voice.en: Next: co-design, test and refine with deaf and hard-of-hearing people.

voice.zh: SoundBridge。感知连接，自主回应。
voice.en: SoundBridge. Feel connected. Choose your response.
